note: hero-idle-sheet.png contains 8 distinct idle-animation frames (a subtle breathing/shifting loop), stepped through by the CSS sprite animation in main.css. The sheet is 800% the width of a single frame; the animation uses steps(frameCount - 1, end) — not steps(frameCount, end) — so each step lands exactly on a frame boundary instead of a fractional offset. The 'wander' behaviour in hero.js (walking toward/away from the venue) is a separate, additional idle behaviour layered on top of this frame animation.
